title: Regiment and Orchard
author: Xanthe Iversen
blurb: Gideon Yarrow, a widowed lighthouse keeper during the year of the great storms, has spent twenty years learning which silences keep people safe. Then the census taker asks one question too many — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
